## Purpose

Epithelial UMAP from the 16 µm spatial data — Figure 3E. Reads a pre-computed epithelial
subset that already carries its PCA and UMAP.

## Outputs

Everything is written to `../outputs/`. Filenames say which is which — anything starting
`fig3E` is the published panel, anything starting `supporting_` is not.

**Manuscript panel (Figure 3E)**

| Output | Panel |
|---|---|
| `fig3E_epithelia_umap.pdf` | 3E — epithelial subset, broad region annotation (9 categories) |

**Supporting — useful for QC and review, but not in any published figure**

| Output | What it is |
|---|---|
| `supporting_epithelia_umap_granular.pdf` | same epithelial UMAP, coloured at the finer (22-category) cluster level |
| `supporting_umap_all_clusters_16um.pdf` | res-2 UMAP of *all* spatial clusters (16 µm object), not just epithelia |

## Why this panel uses the 16 µm data

The published legend has 9 epithelial categories. Clustering the whole object at 8 µm
resolves only 8 of them — enteroendocrine cells never separate into their own cluster at
that resolution and are absent from the 8 µm annotation file entirely. Clustering run
specifically on the epithelial subset at 16 µm does resolve EEC, as cluster 33. This
notebook is the sole source of the panel; the equivalent chunks were removed from
`01_spatial_clusters/Fig3_VisiumHD_final.Rmd`.

## Which annotation file to use

Read `../data/16um-epithelial-annotations-Aug29-FINAL.csv`. It gives 24 clusters, no
unmapped values, and the 9 categories in the published legend.

The older `16um-binned-updated-annotations(res2).csv` is kept on disk for provenance but
is **not** read here — it folds EEC (cluster 33) and Tuft cells (cluster 30) into generic
"Mid-villus" / "Villus" buckets, and labels cluster 31 "Tip-villus proximal" without the
trailing "enterocytes" that every other Tip-villus proximal cluster carries.

## Inputs

| File | What it carries |
|---|---|
| `../data/final_analysis_object_16um.RDS` | 16 µm object, res-2 clusters in `sketch_snn_res.2`, no RCTD — used only for the all-clusters QC UMAP |
| `../outputs/epi_subset_16um.RDS` | pre-computed epithelial subset (229,070 spots) carrying `pca.epi` / `umap.epi` already run — reused as-is, **not** rebuilt, so this notebook does not need to repeat `NormalizeData`/`RunPCA`/`RunUMAP` |
| `../data/16um-epithelial-annotations-Aug29-FINAL.csv` | corrected cluster → region crosswalk (see note above) |

## Running this

Both objects are around 2 GB and fit in memory on a laptop, so no compute node is needed:

```
Rscript Fig3E_16um_final.R
```

# Setup

## Paths and annotation maps

```{r config}
rds_all_clusters <- "../data/final_analysis_object_16um.RDS"
rds_epi          <- "../outputs/epi_subset_16um.RDS"
ann_csv          <- "../data/16um-epithelial-annotations-Aug29-FINAL.csv"
out_dir          <- "../outputs"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

op <- function(f) file.path(out_dir, f)

cluster_col <- "sketch_snn_res.2"   # res-2 cluster IDs, same field in both objects

ann <- read.csv(ann_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ann$Cluster <- as.character(ann$Cluster)

region_map    <- setNames(trimws(ann$Spatial.region.annotation), ann$Cluster)
granular_map  <- setNames(trimws(ann$Annotation),                ann$Cluster)
region_colors <- setNames(trimws(ann$Color), trimws(ann$Spatial.region.annotation))
region_colors <- region_colors[!duplicated(names(region_colors))]

cat("Regions in crosswalk:", length(unique(region_map)), "— published Figure 3E has 9\n")
```

---

# PART 1 — Manuscript panel

## Fig 3E — epithelial subset, broad region annotation

```{r panel_3d_load}
epi.object <- readRDS(rds_epi)
cat("Epithelia subset:", ncol(epi.object), "spots | Reductions:",
    paste(Reductions(epi.object), collapse = ", "), "\n")

cl <- as.character(epi.object@meta.data[[cluster_col]])
epi.object$region_epi_annotation <- unname(region_map[cl])

n_na <- sum(is.na(epi.object$region_epi_annotation))
if (n_na > 0) warning(n_na, " spots have no region mapping — check crosswalk coverage.")

broad_present <- levels(factor(as.character(epi.object$region_epi_annotation)))
cat("Distinct region categories present:", length(broad_present), "— published Figure 3E has 9\n")
print(broad_present)

cols_broad <- if (all(broad_present %in% names(region_colors))) {
  region_colors[broad_present]
} else NULL
```

```{r panel_3d_plot, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
p_epi_broad <- DimPlot(epi.object, reduction = "umap.epi", group.by = "region_epi_annotation",
                       cols = cols_broad, label = TRUE, label.size = 3, repel = TRUE,
                       raster = TRUE, raster.dpi = c(600, 600), pt.size = 1.5) +
  ggtitle("Figure 3E — epithelial subset (16 µm, res 2)") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(op("fig3E_epithelia_umap.pdf"), p_epi_broad, width = 16, height = 12)
p_epi_broad
```

# PART 2 — Supporting figures

Not part of Figure 3E. Kept because they are useful for review and QC.

## Epithelial subset, granular annotation

Same UMAP as the panel above, coloured at the finer (numbered-subcluster) level instead
of the collapsed region label.

```{r supporting_epi_granular, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
epi.object$granular_epi_annotation <- unname(granular_map[cl])

gran_present <- levels(factor(as.character(epi.object$granular_epi_annotation)))
cat("Granular categories present:", length(gran_present), "\n")

p_epi_gran <- DimPlot(epi.object, reduction = "umap.epi", group.by = "granular_epi_annotation",
                      label = TRUE, label.size = 3, repel = TRUE,
                      raster = TRUE, raster.dpi = c(600, 600), pt.size = 1.5) +
  ggtitle("Figure 3E — epithelial subset, granular annotation (16 µm, res 2)") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

ggsave(op("supporting_epithelia_umap_granular.pdf"), p_epi_gran, width = 16, height = 12)
p_epi_gran
```

## All spatial clusters, UMAP (16 µm, not just epithelia)

QC reference showing every compartment (Epithelia / Stroma / Immune), not just the
epithelial subset used for the panel above.

```{r supporting_all_clusters, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
merged.object <- readRDS(rds_all_clusters)
cat("Spots:", ncol(merged.object), "| Reductions:",
    paste(Reductions(merged.object), collapse = ", "), "\n")

cl_all <- as.character(merged.object@meta.data[[cluster_col]])
merged.object$granular_annotation <- unname(granular_map[cl_all])

umap_red <- intersect(c("umap.sketch", "full.umap.sketch", "umap"), Reductions(merged.object))[1]
if (is.na(umap_red)) stop("No UMAP reduction found in the 16 µm object.")

p_umap_all <- DimPlot(merged.object, reduction = umap_red, group.by = "granular_annotation",
                      raster = TRUE, raster.dpi = c(600, 600), pt.size = 1.2, label = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("Spatial clusters (res 2) — 16 µm, all compartments") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

ggsave(op("supporting_umap_all_clusters_16um.pdf"), p_umap_all, width = 11, height = 9)
p_umap_all
```
